features.feature_value: Compared the pair mainly by whether their tone was similarly heated/demeaning rather than by political side; if symmetrical, treated them the same.
features.evidence_span: focused more on whether they were similarly heated or demeaning rather than what political side they came from
features.rationale: The reflection explicitly describes using tone similarity across the pair as the primary basis for decisions.

features.feature_value: Checked whether one post was just a mirror of the other; mirror posts were viewed as disrespectful and not adding discussion.
features.evidence_span: evaluate if the posts were genuinely different, or just a mirror of each other. The mirror posts don't provide further discussion, and come across as disrespectful.
features.rationale: They describe a specific comparison criterion (genuine difference vs mirror) tied to perceived disrespect and lack of added discussion.

features.feature_value: Removal focus on posts that were inflammatory via profanity or that threatened public figures.
features.evidence_span: only concerned if the posts were inflammatory in regards to profanity or threatening to public figures
features.rationale: They name concrete conditions (profanity/inflammatory; threats to public figures) as triggers for removal.

features.feature_value: Removed only if intentionally inflammatory or profanity-laced personal attack; otherwise kept both versions.
features.evidence_span: only removed a post if it was intentionally inflammatory or it was a profanity-laced personal attack. Otherwise, I kept both posts
features.rationale: The participant states a clear keep/remove rule with exception conditions.

features.feature_value: Allowed name calling as long as there was no call to action they felt was inappropriate; grounded in belief in free speech over censoring opinions.
features.evidence_span: I allowed all of them even ones that were name calling because I believe in free speech... none of them madeca call to action
features.rationale: The reflection ties permissiveness to a free-speech rationale and an explicit boundary (no inappropriate call to action).

features.feature_value: Saying they became more objective side-by-side; treated both as the same kind of heated venting unless crossing lines like hate, threats, or doxing.
features.evidence_span: seeing them side by side made it a lot easier to stay objective
features.rationale: They connect the paired view directly to increased objectivity and fairness judgments.

features.feature_value: Loved both sides and allowed heated language if there is some merit/truth; emphasized protecting free speech.
features.evidence_span: As long as there is some merit of truth or resemblance, I allowed it. I think we should always protect free speech
features.rationale: They describe a specific criterion (merit/truth/resemblance) combined with a free-speech principle.

features.feature_value: Stated ideological identification (communist) and supported the communist posts.
features.evidence_span: I'm a communist. I supported the communist posts.
features.rationale: The decision basis is explicitly ideological, not procedural pair-comparison or content moderation criteria.
